focusedTests.redReason: Exact Original transport, choice, synchronized catalog and prefill not yet implemented.
scope: Exact tuple and mixed candidate transport; reject wrong slots, IDs, malformed tuples, extra keys, unsupported versions and oversized input.
Verified Tasks scope on both frames; basket changes do not navigate or replace comparison frames.
Null-receipt-only prefill and pinned native selection; retained or unknown receipts are not replaced.
Real React Control and TaskListRow binding: initial Handbook draft, explicit restore, enter, apply, return and admission withdrawal.

browser.scope: Actual local synthetic preview, not a published-site test.
observations: Comparison link opened a fresh native Tasks tab with revision 0 and empty undo in import text; live basket still Handbook, product mode active and Apply disabled.
Explicit pointer Restore changed the basket without applying. Enter made product content inert, aria-hidden and pointer-events:none.
Apply retained the mixed basket and rendered the Original title with computed color #272343 and a Noto Sans TC font-family stack. Font-file loading was not independently verified.
Return removed interaction suppression; same-row pointer open/close removed taskId and kept focus and the title styling.
Native routing removed the handoff URL fields while the basket and appearance persisted.

independentReview: No blocking source/contract findings or material contradiction in final bounded browser evidence.
uncompleted: Complete Original identity, multi-slot composition and global theme remain unverified.
Draft restoration across browser reload is not implemented; storage remains disabled.
